headline: SONY Q1 Earnings & Sales Rise on Gaming & Sensors, FY26 View Lifted
summary: Sony raises fiscal 2026 guidance after Q1 EPS climbed 35%, sales rose 8.2% and operating margin expanded to 16.8%, led by sensors and music.
